mapper.sql: c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.created_at, c.updated_at, p.name AS product_name, p.type AS product_type, p.price, p.stock, p.status AS product_status, p.deleted_at AS product_deleted_at, f.bucket AS cover_bucket, f.object_key AS cover_object_key
FROM cart_item c JOIN product p ON p.id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN file_object f ON f.id = p.cover_file_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (user_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
